captions_note: the page sits above the head and the reel's captions stay on the chest band over it, the same as in a normal shot
in_a_reel: make the slot ACROSS the cut after the line: from just before the line to about 0.4 s into the next shot. The exit is a zoom blur that peaks on the cut; nothing of the page stays after it
MASTHEAD, coverlines and sticker are words from the line, or the buyer's own: no real publication's name or logo

the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style for the coverlines (line_font, line_weight, line_ink) before the first build; keep a display serif for the masthead unless the style has its own
steps: edit the CLIP block: MASTHEAD, TOP_LINE, LEFT, RIGHT, TICKET, STICKER and the AT_ words
run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the page's place, the times and the snapshot times
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
